verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned model families (Llama 2 through Llama 4), each with its own model card, and a 'llama-model' CLI. It contains nothing about a versioned API or a documented deprecation or sunset policy. Probes for OpenAPI specs all returned 404, and the developer docs sit behind an SSO wall, so no API versioning contract is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
